name: mcp-pack
description: Bundle of MCP servers that follow you across every repo and superset worktree. Infra: Mapbox docs + DevKit, Proxyman. Motion: Higgsfield (AI cinematic video). Static assets: Recraft (vector SVG), Nano-Banana (Gemini Flash Image), Iconify (icon search), Unsplash (stock photo), Playwright (visual review). Neon and Grafana moved to claude.ai connectors (hosted remote MCPs with OAuth) so cloud sessions get them too. Enable at user scope so all sessions get them. Secrets read from shell env vars wrapped by Infisical — never committed.

higgsfield.comment: v1.2.2 switched from npm jfikrat/higgsfield-mcp to PyPI Hikhakk/higgsfield-mcp-unified (uvx). Same platform.higgsfield.ai endpoint + key+secret auth, but correct official-API model slugs — fixes Seedance v1 Pro 404 and routes per-model to the right backend. Web backend (Sora 2 / Veo 3 / Kling 3.0) NOT opted in (HIGGSFIELD_ENABLE_WEB_BACKEND missing); those require the consumer subscription path. Pay-as-you-go cloud credits at cloud.higgsfield.ai cover the 8 official-API models.
